name: Dura-Ace square-taper bottom bracket
weight_description: No manufacturer weight is given for the complete BB-7200 assembly with an identified spindle. The source lists 112 mm for a 68 mm shell and 113 mm for a 70 mm shell; these are options, not weighed references.
